description: The bar chart illustrates the quality scores for two categories, IFD and DEITA, with each category having three associated bars representing different averages. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as IFD and DEITA, while the vertical axis is labeled "Scores" and has a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70 with a tick label interval of 5. The bars for each category are grouped together, with the first bar in each group colored blue and labeled as "Avg eq", the second bar being very short and gray, and the third bar colored pink and labeled as "Avg sup". For IFD, the blue "Avg eq" bar has a value of approximately 63.98, the gray bar is very short, and the pink "Avg sup" bar has a value of around 41.90. For DEITA, the blue "Avg eq" bar has a value of approximately 67.64, the gray bar is again very short, and the pink "Avg sup" bar has a value of around 42.99. Two dashed lines are also present, a blue line labeled "Base Avg eq" at a value of around 64.71 and an orange line labeled "Base Avg sup" at a value of around 38. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the coloring and labeling.
